title: PyPI Project Metadata
description: Core metadata for a Python package hosted on PyPI, as returned by the JSON API. This schema captures the info object that describes authorship, licensing, dependencies, and classification of a project.

name.description: The name of the Python package.

version.description: The version string of the release, following PEP 440.

summary.description: A one-line summary of what the package does.

description.description: The full description of the package, which may be in reStructuredText, Markdown, or plain text.

description_content_type.description: The content type of the description field.

author.description: The name of the package author.

author_email.description: The email address of the package author.

maintainer.description: The name of the package maintainer.

maintainer_email.description: The email address of the package maintainer.

license.description: The license text or identifier for the package.

license_expression.description: A SPDX license expression for the package.

license_files.description: A list of license file paths included in the distribution.

classifiers.description: Trove classifiers indicating the package maturity, audience, license, and supported environments.

home_page.description: The URL of the project home page.

project_url.description: The canonical URL of the project on PyPI.

project_urls.description: A mapping of label strings to URL strings for project-related links.

requires_python.description: The Python version requirement specifier, following PEP 440.

requires_dist.description: A list of PEP 508 dependency specifiers required by the package.

provides_extra.description: A list of optional extra dependency groups provided by the package.

dynamic.description: Metadata fields that are dynamically specified at build time.

yanked.description: Whether this release has been yanked from the index.

yanked_reason.description: The reason the release was yanked, if applicable.

ReleaseFile.description: Metadata about a single distribution file within a release.

filename.description: The name of the distribution file.

url.description: The download URL for the distribution file.

size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

python_version.description: The Python version this distribution targets.

requires_python.description: The Python version requirement for this file.

upload_time_iso_8601.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the file was uploaded.

yanked.description: Whether this file has been yanked.

yanked_reason.description: The reason the file was yanked.

Digests.description: Cryptographic hash digests for a distribution file.

md5.description: MD5 hash digest of the file.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash digest of the file.

blake2b_256.description: BLAKE2b-256 hash digest of the file.

Vulnerability.description: A known security vulnerability affecting the project.

id.description: The unique identifier of the vulnerability, such as a CVE or PYSEC ID.

summary.description: A brief summary of the vulnerability.

details.description: A detailed description of the vulnerability.

fixed_in.description: Version strings in which the vulnerability was fixed.

link.description: A URL with more information about the vulnerability.
